pathAssistantSteps.info:
• The case has been fully resolved, and the client has been informed.
  • Confirm that all follow-ups have been completed.
  • Capture any relevant learnings or feedback for future process improvements.
  • Ensure proper documentation for compliance and audit purposes.

• The case requires urgent attention or involvement from senior advisors, compliance, or other teams.
  • Clearly document the reason for escalation and actions taken so far.
  • Maintain frequent communication with all stakeholders for a swift resolution.

• The case has been created and requires initial assessment.
  • Ensure all relevant details (client information, case type, priority) are captured.
  • Assign ownership promptly to avoid delays.

• The case is actively being handled by the assigned advisor or support team.
  • Keep case notes updated with actions taken and client interactions.
  • If additional information is needed from the client, request it promptly.
  • Aim to resolve within the expected SLA based on case priority.
